change_reason: Official JV-Data semantic correction before any real capture or model execution.
rules: feature_source_time_jst and source_capture_time_jst must be offset-aware and no later than prediction_snapshot_time_jst.
OFFICIAL_ANNOUNCEMENT source time must be no later than capture time.
LOCAL_ACQUISITION source time must equal capture time.
Each feature is fail-closed to approved source kinds.
Each source hash must be independently recomputed from the source manifest.
Outcome fields cannot be used as prediction features.
For 0B14 bulk polling, use only the latest complete 0B14 capture acquired by the prediction snapshot; do not carry forward an event missing from a later complete capture.
AV data division maps only to scratch_exclusion_code: 1=scratch, 2=exclusion.
WE turf and dirt track-condition codes stay separate until current surface is independently snapshot-safe.
WH body-weight change code 000 means zero kg change.
